#mrsfisher.Mouth.normal
Mrs. Fisher: I’m impressed. You look fine. 
You: Really?
Mrs. Fisher: Really. Of course that doesn’t mean you can stop being careful about this.
You: Sure.
Mrs. Fisher: As I said before, we need to end this as soon as you regain your memories from these trips. You have some rare condition that is causing these issues. It’s not dangerous now, but if you try going too deep into your mind it might have unforeseen consequences.
You: Alright, I get it. Of course I wouldn’t want that.
